effect_description_eng: [Your Turn] [Once Per Turn] When this Digimon gets linked, if you have 1 or fewer Tamers, you may play 1 [Haru Shinkai] from your hand without paying the cost.
link_effect_description_eng: ＜Raid＞ (When this Digimon attacks, you may change the attack target to 1 of your opponent's unsuspended Digimon with the highest DP.)
